mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 units, sustained for 2 months, indicates strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4.5% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200k jobs per month for 2 consecutive months, it signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to impending monetary tightening.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS growth > 200k for 2 consecutive months
evidence_refs: fact:historical relationship between labor market and monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
